_comment: Purple Line anti-bunching: a bus sitting at `stage` leaves about offset_s after the bus ahead of it reaches `trigger` (stop names matched by substring). Hours are local start hours, inclusive. Offsets are the medians measured 2026-08-20..09-30 (weekdays) minus 30 s, an early lean so fewer riders miss a bus that goes before the rule says (replay 2026-10-18, see purple_release.py). Hours not listed fall back to the dwell history.
